4336-5006-8170-8227.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-8170-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
4336-5006-8170-8227.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Loot by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-4976--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-4976--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

643-4302-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
643-4302-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2425-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2178-3899-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-3899-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1661-3899-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-3899-4871-5220.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1981-2415-2842-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

654-2557-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3384-4067-6480-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
3384-4067-6480-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1368-4742-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4742-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3525-3755-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2511-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

567-2919-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-2919-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

703-5399-7149.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Pirated Copy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Pirated Copy dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Pirated Copy enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Pirated Copys into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Pirated Copy tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-5399-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

765-1558-3875-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-3875-4231-6753.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1491-2113-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3011-4090-7186.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
3011-4090-7186.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
3011-4090-7186.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1336-1978-3263.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat

147-313-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-2438.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3129-3951-5703-5744.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3129-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-719-1879-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-1879-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

751-1671-1741-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional land that can tap to produce {U}
751-1671-1741-5914.notes:
If you control a second land that produces two or more mana, this also produces infinite mana.

If you have a creature with mana value 0 that can survive after being cast for 0 mana, you can bounce it each time in step 9 and also cast it infinite times.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ojer Taq

178-1270-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Auton Soldier does not have summoning sickness.
178-1270-5361.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker.
Auton Soldier's myriad ability and Adeline trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, creating nine token copies of itself as a nonlegendary copy of Ojer Taq attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the Adeline trigger, creating 3^(the number of Ojer Taqs you control) 1/1 Human creature tokens tapped and attacking each opponent.

573-1479-1692.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Kodama of the East Tree.
Helm of the Host attached to Kodama of the East Tree.
573-1479-1692.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Gruul Turf.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

565-974-1444.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
565-974-1444.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting the Smaug token.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put the new Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Elvish Fury from step 2, giving the Smaug token +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control using Elvish Fury, to create infinite tokens of them using Orvar.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3359-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Squee dies, triggering Hofri, exiling Squee and creating a token copy of it that's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {R}.
The Squee token dies, returning Squee from exile to your graveyard.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2665-3277-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
2665-3277-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the token Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4377-5021-5261.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Noxious Revival without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Noxious Revival, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
